title: Leaderboard Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the Sports Leaderboard plugin

enabled.description: Enable or disable the leaderboard plugin

display_duration.description: Deprecated: ignored. Kept for backward compatibility with existing configs. The leaderboard uses global.display_duration.
display_duration.title: Display Duration (deprecated)

update_interval.description: How often to fetch new leaderboard data in seconds

display_duration.description: Duration in seconds to display the leaderboard

scroll_speed.description: Deprecated: ignored. Kept for backward compatibility with existing configs. Scroll speed comes from global.display.scroll_speed / scroll_delay.
scroll_speed.title: Scroll Speed (deprecated)

target_fps.description: Deprecated: ignored. Kept for backward compatibility with existing configs.
target_fps.title: Target FPS (deprecated)

scroll_speed_scale.description: Deprecated: ignored. Kept for backward compatibility with existing configs.
scroll_speed_scale.title: Scroll Speed Scale (deprecated)

dynamic_duration.description: Dynamic duration settings for synchronising display time with content width

enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration based on content width

min_duration_seconds.description: Minimum display duration when dynamic duration is enabled

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum display duration when dynamic duration is enabled

buffer_ratio.description: Extra buffer applied to the calculated duration (percentage expressed as 0-1)

controller_cap_seconds.description: Failsafe cap for the display controller when dynamic duration is enabled

min_duration.title: Min Duration (deprecated)
min_duration.description: Deprecated: use dynamic_duration.min_duration_seconds. Kept for backward compatibility with existing configs; applies only while dynamic_duration.min_duration_seconds is at its default.

max_duration.title: Max Duration (deprecated)
max_duration.description: Deprecated: use dynamic_duration.max_duration_seconds. Kept for backward compatibility with existing configs; applies only while dynamic_duration.max_duration_seconds is at its default.

duration_buffer.title: Duration Buffer (deprecated)
duration_buffer.description: Deprecated: use dynamic_duration.buffer_ratio. Kept for backward compatibility with existing configs; applies only while dynamic_duration.buffer_ratio is at its default.

max_display_time.title: Max Display Time (deprecated)
max_display_time.description: Deprecated: use dynamic_duration.controller_cap_seconds. Kept for backward compatibility with existing configs; applies only while dynamic_duration.controller_cap_seconds is at its default.

scroll_pixels_per_second.description: Deprecated: ignored. Kept for backward compatibility with existing configs. Scroll speed comes from global.display.scroll_speed / scroll_delay.
scroll_pixels_per_second.title: Scroll Pixels Per Second (deprecated)

scroll_speed.description: Pixels moved per scroll step. With scroll_delay it sets the speed: scroll_speed / scroll_delay pixels per second (100 by default), snapped to the nearest speed the panel can move in whole pixels

scroll_delay.description: Delay between scroll steps in seconds

scroll_target_fps.description: Deprecated: ignored. Kept for backward compatibility with existing configs.
scroll_target_fps.title: Scroll Target FPS (deprecated)

scroll_direction.description: Deprecated: ignored. Kept for backward compatibility with existing configs.
scroll_direction.title: Scroll Direction (deprecated)

enable_scroll_metrics.description: Deprecated: ignored. Kept for backward compatibility with existing configs.
enable_scroll_metrics.title: Enable Scroll Metrics (deprecated)

scroll_delay.description: Deprecated: ignored. Kept for backward compatibility with existing configs. Scroll speed comes from global.display.scroll_speed / scroll_delay.
scroll_delay.title: Scroll Delay (deprecated)

appearance.description: Pixel-perfect rendering options for text and logos

pixel_perfect_text.description: Render text with hard pixel edges. Disable only if you prefer the older anti-aliased (softer, blurrier) look

crisp_logos.description: Give logos hard edges instead of a ring of half-lit pixels

text_outline.description: Draw a black outline around text so it stays readable over logos

logo_scale.description: Logo height as a fraction of the panel height. 1.0 fits the panel exactly; above 1.0 crops the top and bottom of every logo

font_size.description: Font size in pixels. 0 picks a size that suits the panel height. Values are snapped to the font's pixel grid (multiples of 8 for Press Start 2P) to keep text sharp

top_teams.description: Number of top NFL teams to display. 0 shows every team the standings return (up to 32). Long lists need a matching display duration - see the README
Number of top NBA teams to display. 0 shows every team the standings return (up to 30). Long lists need a matching display duration - see the README
Number of top MLB teams to display. 0 shows every team the standings return (up to 30). Long lists need a matching display duration - see the README
Number of top NCAA Football teams to display. 0 shows every team the standings return (up to 130). Long lists need a matching display duration - see the README

show_ranking.description: Show NCAA Football rankings instead of standings

top_teams.description: Number of top NHL teams to display. 0 shows every team the standings return (up to 32). Long lists need a matching display duration - see the README
Number of top NCAA Men's Basketball teams to display. 0 shows every team the standings return (up to 350). Long lists need a matching display duration - see the README

show_ranking.description: Show rankings/seeds instead of sequential numbering. During March Madness, automatically shows tournament seeds.

top_teams.description: Number of top NCAA Men's Hockey teams to display. 0 shows every team the standings return (up to 60). Long lists need a matching display duration - see the README

show_ranking.description: Show NCAA Men's Hockey rankings instead of standings

top_teams.description: Number of top NCAA Women's Basketball teams to display. 0 shows every team the standings return (up to 350). Long lists need a matching display duration - see the README

show_ranking.description: Show rankings/seeds instead of sequential numbering. During March Madness, automatically shows tournament seeds.

top_teams.description: Number of top NCAA Baseball teams to display. 0 shows every team the standings return (up to 350). Long lists need a matching display duration - see the README

season.description: Season identifier (e.g. '2026'). Omit to use the current ESPN season.

level.description: Competition level (1 = Division I, 2 = Division II, 3 = Division III)

sort.description: Sort key and order for standings
